parsed.why: Worst dossier: criminal indecent-exposure bathroom statute, birth-sex facilities/prison/shelter rules, drag ban, closed IDs, care ban, no GI hate-crime, police indifference and panic defence. State-imposed universal exposure.

Hostile local layer: birth-certificate marker ban, bathroom restriction in state facilities, school outing rules, no GI anti-discrimination or hate-crime coverage. No criminal presentation ban or documented violence.

No bathroom ban or presentation criminalisation; care ban for minors and one hospital adult-surgery halt, but health-plan coverage survives. City violence is raw counts, under investigation, no denominator.

Protective state law: public-accommodation anti-discrimination, GI hate-crime, open state IDs, care sanctuary, panic-defence ban. National border/document and federal-facility regime still caps score.
National seat under direct national law; low-risk legal ranking but national-legislature bathroom ban in force, protest arrests, and override risk. Scope uncertain, so only modestly below parent.
